about.text: The everyday yoghurt of Iraq, eaten with bread for breakfast. Ordinary liban is made by mixing milk with yoghurt from the previous batch and leaving it for 18 to 20 hours. Smoked liban from Erbil is sterilised in a copper pot, partly scorched for flavour, then set with a back-slopped starter.

sources.text: The Liban and smoked Liban sections of this review.
